# Shop Sigvaris

> > Medical-grade compression socks, stockings, and hosiery designed by doctors for circulation health and venous conditions.

Shop Sigvaris is the official e-commerce platform for Sigvaris compression wear, a globally trusted brand recommended by doctors in 100+ countries. The site provides medical-grade compression garments for various conditions including varicose veins and deep vein thrombosis, along with educational resources and sizing guides.

## Key Topics

- Compression socks
- Compression stockings
- Medical-grade compression
- mmHg (compression levels)
- Graduated compression
- Varicose veins
- Deep vein thrombosis (DVT)
- Circulation health
- Compression therapy
- Medical hosiery
- Donning aids
- Leg health
- Circulation support
- Sigvaris brand
- Compression wear

## Core Collections

- [Knee High Compression Stockings](https://www.shopsigvaris.com/collections/calf-women): Women's knee-high compression stockings collection in multiple fabrics and compression levels.
- [Thigh High Compression Stockings](https://www.shopsigvaris.com/collections/womens-thigh-high-compression): Women's thigh-high graduated compression stockings with cotton and opaque options.
- [Compression Pantyhose](https://www.shopsigvaris.com/collections/womens-pantyhose): Women's compression pantyhose collection with sheer and opaque styles.
- [Compression Socks for Men](https://www.shopsigvaris.com/collections/calf-mens): Men's calf and knee-high compression socks in merino wool and other fabrics.
- [Men's Thigh High Compression Stockings](https://www.shopsigvaris.com/collections/mens-thigh-high-compression): Men's thigh-high graduated compression stockings with cotton and opaque options.
- [Maternity Compression Collection](https://www.shopsigvaris.com/collections/maternity): Sigvaris maternity compression socks and stockings for pregnancy support.
- [Women's Soft Silhouette Leggings](https://www.shopsigvaris.com/products/womens-soft-silhouette-leggings): Women's stylish 15-20mmHg compression leggings with subtle ribbed design.
